title: C2PA Asset Rubric
description: Schema for validating C2PA Asset Rubric multi-document YAML files. The Python validator assembles the parsed documents into {"information_block": <doc0>, "sections": [<doc1>, ...]} before validating.

sections.description: One or more statement sections (YAML documents 2+), each a list of statements and/or data blocks.

ml_dict.title: Multilingual text dictionary
ml_dict.description: Maps BCP 47 language tags (e.g. "en", "fr") to the corresponding text.

reportText_value.description: A single report-text value: either a plain string or a multilingual dict.

reportText.description: The reportText field. May be a plain string, a multilingual dict, or a mapping keyed by the string literals "true" and/or "false" whose values are plain strings or multilingual dicts.

oneOf.description: Boolean-keyed report text (keys are the string literals "true" and/or "false").

title_field.description: A section/statement title: plain string or multilingual dict.

rubric_metadata.title: rubric_metadata
rubric_metadata.description: Mandatory metadata block for the asset rubric.

name.description: Human-readable name of the asset rubric.

issuer.description: Name of the organisation or person that issued this profile.

date.description: ISO 8601 date/datetime when the profile was issued.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the default language used in non-multilingual text fields.

variables.title: variables
variables.description: Named constants available in expressions. Every key must start with '$'.

expressions.title: expressions
expressions.description: Named JMESPath expressions available globally. Every key must start with '_'.

include.title: include
include.description: Paths to asset rubric snippet files to include (absolute or relative).

information_block.title: Information block (YAML document 1)
information_block.description: The first YAML document in an asset rubric. Must contain rubric_metadata; may also contain variables, expressions, include directives, and arbitrary custom mappings.

statement_id.description: Unique statement identifier within the profile. Alphanumeric, underscores, dots, hyphens, and colons allowed. The prefix 'c2pa:' is reserved for predefined identifiers.

information_statement.title: Information statement
information_statement.description: Provides a title and/or static text in the report without evaluating any expression.

expression_statement.title: Expression statement
expression_statement.description: Evaluates a JMESPath expression against the crJSON and writes the result to the report.

specSection.description: Reference section in the C2PA specification.

data_block.title: Data block
data_block.description: Extracts or computes a named value to include in the report.

section_item.description: A single item within a statement section: a data block, an expression statement, or an information statement.

section.title: Statement section (YAML document 2+)
section.description: A YAML document (after the information block) containing an ordered list of statements and/or data blocks.
